top_choice_rationale: P001 (Crews, Deshaies, Handa) rewards induced proximity, a new design principle for small-molecule action, with an atomic structural account in ternary-complex co-crystal structures and a molecular explanation of thalidomide-type glues via cereblon; the cereblon branch is clinically established, the three names map onto separable steps, and the citation can be written around mechanism rather than the unapproved PROTAC count. P002 (lipid nanoparticles) is next for maturity and impact, though the Vancouver versus lipidoid attribution is unsettled. P003 (C-N coupling) is mature and cleanly attributed but reads partly as a completion of the 2010 cross-coupling prize. A prize is preferable to no award.
recusal_note: none apparent from profile beyond being a Stockholm University colleague of Secretary Peter Brzezinski, who also supports P001; no tie to any credited laureate
